name: openscad2: kernel and the OpenSCAD engine load
openscad2: a program that reads $t opens; the PropertyManager shows the animation (time, FPS, steps, frame) and the export buttons
openscad2: the frame slider sets $t (frame 10 of 20 → $t = 0.5, the cube 15 long)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { rep } = await import('/src/cad/kernel.js'); const vol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart(m.active()).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; const feat = () => m.active()?.features?.find((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); const editIt = async () => { const f = feat(); m.state.selection = [{ kind: 'feat', id: f.id, key: 'feat:' + f.id }]; await m.run('editFeature'); await sleep(500); }; const draft = () => m.state.editing?.feature; const setAnim = async (k, v) => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-scad-anim="' + k + '"]'); el.value = String(v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(300); }; const editVol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart({ ...m.active(), features: m.active().features.map((f) => (f.id === draft()?.id ? draft() : f)) }).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; await setAnim('frame', 10); return JSON.stringify({ t: draft().animT, vol: Math.round(editVol()), note: /11/.test(document.querySelector('.pm-note')?.parentElement?.textContent ?? '') }); })()

name: openscad2: Play steps the frames on; Pause stops them
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { rep } = await import('/src/cad/kernel.js'); const vol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart(m.active()).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; const feat = () => m.active()?.features?.find((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); const editIt = async () => { const f = feat(); m.state.selection = [{ kind: 'feat', id: f.id, key: 'feat:' + f.id }]; await m.run('editFeature'); await sleep(500); }; const draft = () => m.state.editing?.feature; const setAnim = async (k, v) => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-scad-anim="' + k + '"]'); el.value = String(v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(300); }; const editVol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart({ ...m.active(), features: m.active().features.map((f) => (f.id === draft()?.id ? draft() : f)) }).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; await setAnim('fps', 20); const t0 = draft().animT; await m.actions.pmCommand('scadAnimPlay'); await sleep(700); const moving = draft().animT !== t0; const label = document.querySelector('[data-pm="scadAnimPlay"]')?.textContent; await m.actions.pmCommand('scadAnimPlay'); const t1 = draft().animT; await sleep(400); return JSON.stringify({ moving, pauseShown: /Pause|일시/.test(label), stopped: draft().animT === t1 }); })()

name: openscad2: Dump pictures saves every frame as a PNG (frame00000.png …) in one ZIP
openscad2: the result exports as CSG tree, OFF and AMF (with $t in effect)

(async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { rep } = await import('/src/cad/kernel.js'); const vol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart(m.active()).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; const feat = () => m.active()?.features?.find((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); const editIt = async () => { const f = feat(); m.state.selection = [{ kind: 'feat', id: f.id, key: 'feat:' + f.id }]; await m.run('editFeature'); await sleep(500); }; const draft = () => m.state.editing?.feature; const setAnim = async (k, v) => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-scad-anim="' + k + '"]'); el.value = String(v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(300); }; const editVol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart({ ...m.active(), features: m.active().features.map((f) => (f.id === draft()?.id ? draft() : f)) }).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; const files = {}; await m.actions.withExportSink(async (name, type, content) => { files[name.split('.').pop()] = await content.text(); return true; }, async () => { for (const f of ['csg', 'off', 'amf']) await m.actions.pmCommand('scadExport:' + f); });
     return JSON.stringify({ csg: /cube\(size = \[15, 10, 10\], center = false\);/.test(files.csg), off: /^OFF

name: openscad2: accepting keeps the roof; the part exports as OFF and AMF from Export

(async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { rep } = await import('/src/cad/kernel.js'); const vol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart(m.active()).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; const feat = () => m.active()?.features?.find((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); const editIt = async () => { const f = feat(); m.state.selection = [{ kind: 'feat', id: f.id, key: 'feat:' + f.id }]; await m.run('editFeature'); await sleep(500); }; const draft = () => m.state.editing?.feature; const setAnim = async (k, v) => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-scad-anim="' + k + '"]'); el.value = String(v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(300); }; const editVol = () => { const b = m.actions.buildPart({ ...m.active(), features: m.active().features.map((f) => (f.id === draft()?.id ? draft() : f)) }).body; return b ? rep().measureVolume(b) : 0; }; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await sleep(500); const files = {}; await m.actions.withExportSink(async (name, type, content) => { files[type] = typeof content === 'string' ? content : await content.text(); return true; }, async () => { await m.actions.exportModel('off'); await m.actions.exportModel('amf'); });
     return JSON.stringify({ vol: Math.round(vol() * 1000) / 1000, off: /^OFF/.test(files.off ?? ''), amf: /<amf /.test(files.amf ?? '') }); })()
